body.name: \mathsf R_m(\mathbf r,\mathbf s)

body.def: The candidate shared-law regret obtained by maximizing \(\mathsf D_{mj}(\mathbf r,\mathbf s)\) over \(j\in\mathcal M\), defined in \(\text{def:perspective-regret-functional}\).
